title: Edmund and the Promise
author: Mara Okafor
blurb: Odile Okonkwo, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
